title: Charles Hoskinson in Russian
problem: There is low penetration of Cardano philosophy and vision in non-English speaking countries, that constitute 83% of world population.
solution: Translate in Russian Charles Hoskinson's YouTube videos (3 months period) to promote Cardano philosophy to 3% population.

title: PCDiscord Miro board for Onboarding
problem: It takes time to maintain and moderate a large Discord channel
solution: Create a one-page Miro guideline board to introduce the Discord server and its members

title: Slush Collaboration
problem: Lack of exposure in the entrepreneur networks outside crypto economy and blockchain circles.
solution: Get access to the entrepreneur and investor network of the biggest startup event of the year, Slush (www.slush.org).

title: Free Commerce payment gateway
problem: Enabling the sales of goods and services for crypto requires intermediaries who control the seller's money and charge fees/commissions.
solution: To build an intermediary & commission-free payment gateway where native tokens (esp. stablecoins) & ADA flow directly from buyer to seller.

title: Prepaid Debit Card
problem: We can use QR codes to send ADA to each other, but can we buy a cup of coffee with ADA?
solution: Prepaid card could be a link between today's analog world and digital payment future that we all strive for.

title: Incentivizing Interaction (Phase 2)
problem: Much-needed breakthrough innovations can be achieved by incentivizing interactions among people from different backgrounds.
solution: Incentivising interaction among people of different backgrounds (the greater the difference, the bigger the reward) brings about innovations

title: Online cardano store for SPO's
problem: There is no single spot to find good gear 2 market for SPO's, or anything cardano. A central hub to Cardano gear for all! With deals 4 SPO's
solution: I intend to rent a space and finance, a t-shirts/mugs printing press. Eventually as i grow, look to purchase new machines for new products.

title: Banking The Unbanked
problem: 272M migrants around the world sending their hard earn 1.76T USD back home through underground remittance.
solution: To develop a stable-coin remittance system that provides a smooth user experience, utilizing Blockchain to give financial access to anyone.

title: Deqree: Certificate Validation 🎓
problem: India has an increasing problem of counterfeit degrees with no reliable way for recruiters to verify an applicant's educational credentials.
solution: Develop a cost effective dApp platform to validate certificate credentials using transaction metadata and a native token.

title: NFT-DAO EZ-Honor contribution token
problem: Open-source projects need a scalable way to recognize, reward & bolster reputation of committed contributors & incent good decision-making.
solution: Develop a staged approach to tokenomics that will enable a progression from simple, through intermediate to complex token incentivisation.

title: +WADA Capacity=Smart Catalyst Users
problem: WADA's capacity is currently limited by their web app capacity. They need their own solid integrated management system to optimize activity.
solution: Build WADA a solid, scalable, distributed, proof of concept system/ Dapp from the ground up using Servant Server, Haskell, and Elm.

title: Arnot - iOS SDK
problem: Mobile devs who want to integrate Cardano, have to build their own replica of tools, which requires knowledge of cryptography.
solution: Create a software development kit (SDK) in Swift. Lay a foundation for building mobile Cardano apps without knowing cryptographic internals.

title: Promptous Dental Benefits DApp
problem: 82 million people in the US are without dental insurance, meaning they lack a way to afford dental procedures
solution: Promptous is building a DApp providing discount schedules to individuals to reduce the cost dental services

title: Quality-Assurance-DAO
problem: A lack of advocacy for open source
solution:
Innovative approach to open source
Reform PM to distributed peer facilitation.
Adapt maturity standards to distributed organizations.

title: dApps for Designers and Creatives
problem: There are very few designers adopting blockchain into their work. How can we make Cardano the preferred choice for creatives?
solution: Build a Creative Engine for Cardano, by directly connecting design applications to Cardano

title: Decentralized real estate
problem: The housing industry doesn't cater to people living as digital nomads.
solution: A tokenized platform for real estate investment and bookings, connecting people to a global community of nomads living this lifestyle.

title: Mosaic: fNFT Native Token Mint
problem: NFT's stagnate because of high prices, limiting access, artist royalties, and price discovery. Fractional NFT's democratize premium assets.
solution: Mint fractional NFT's: Liquidity spurs price discovery, volume increases royalties, shared ownership promotes communities & accessibility.

title: DEX, Cardano Decentralized Exchange
problem: Blockchain-agnostic decentralized exchange with liquidity staking and farming, crypto indexes, derivatives, mirrored assets, and daemons.
solution: Liquidity, index, derivatives, mirrored assets, smart contracts, cutting edge stack (React.js UI, Haskell backend, GraphQL API, Kubernetes).

title: Teens Blockchain Summer Bootcamp
problem: "In most parts of Africa, ignorance and poor education about Blockchain technology has led to a lot of misconceptions"
solution: Organize a summer Bootcamp for teenagers between the ages of (13 - 19 years old) in order to begin to introduce them to Blockchain.

title: Blockchain Authentication Mechanism
problem: In order to ensure true decentralisation to services and dApps, a blockchain friendly authentication mechanism should be ideated.
solution: Implement a decentralised authentication mechanism that will persist on chain, secrets and permissions based on metadata and native assets.

title: Native tokens for physical assets
problem: Physical assets (like artwork, real estate, businesses etc) lack a standard for representation on the blockchain as tokens
solution: Create a community standard that tokenization of physical assets must conform to, to help improve quality, security and ultimately adoption

title: Catalyst Site: Education resources
problem: The educational resources, links and calendar dates for Catalyst are scattered and don't have a friendly user interface.
solution: Create a user friendly calendar page and aggregated resources for learning about Catalyst.

title: Control your data – privacy ledger
problem: People can control (use of) their data via (legal) data rights. However, people don't know how to use/exercise them to their advantage
solution: People use Profila's App to learn + exercise data rights; the privacy metadata ledger then provides legal proof = "unsubscribe on steroids"

title: COINLAND
problem: Many african countries suffer from malnutrition and food insufficiency because +50% of cultivable land are unexploited
solution: Tokenize the usufruct of these unexploited cultivable land so that they could be exploited for agri business purposes

title: smartstakepool.io
problem: Stakepools have limited functionality for distro or rewards. It's very hard to teach the average joe in 123 how to delegate to a stake pool.
solution: Create a Dapp that turns a Stakepool into a Smart-Stakepool. Instant SSO sign in, wallet creation, stakepool and charity selection and DONE!

title: FREE MONEY Direct Marketing
problem: Entrepreneurs need seed funding to develop ideas into minimum viable products with marketable potential.
solution: Work with WW Entrepreneurial Community Builders to drive awareness of alternative funding thru Catalyst for blockchain projects.

title: BitBunny.io: Adopt animals w/ NFT
problem: NFTs are not being used to their fullest potential-- As a means to represent tangible real-world assets in the blockchain.
solution: Bitbuny.io will offer a fun proof-of-concept way to experiment with new representation of blockchain assets with the goal of adding value.

title: Educational videos (adatruth)
problem: Most people don't understand what Cardano is about.
solution: Short, precisely articulated educational videos will work as a gateway to Cardano attracting developers / ada holders. Watch trailer below.

title: Burblr - let's make books fun.
problem: NFTs are confusing. There's a need for an intuitive Dapp that can bridge the gap between mass adoption, utility, and most importantly, fun.
solution: Team Burblr is connecting humans to Cardano by allowing them to collect and trade NFT audio/eBooks in a gamified way, with a credit card.

title: Responsible Investing Dapp
problem: Securing gains from crypto investments takes discipline, precision, and consistency. Something a lot of us lack in this space!
solution: Dapp that automatically converts a percentage of holdings (ada) to a stable coin when your crypto increases by a specified percentage.

title: Make DApp for Worldwide Gardening!
problem: Climate has changed.
solution:
It's time to bring simple concepts about taking care of the earth to the forefront.
Healthy activities, sustainable jobs, earth renewal, etc

title: NFT-DAO EZ-Name
problem: Machine-readable IDs like Cardano addresses, other cryptocurrency addresses, content hashes, and metadata are not human centered design.
solution: Improve user experience by mapping human-readable names like 'alice.ada' to machine-readable identifiers such as Cardano addresses.

title: Wallet Name System (WNS)
problem: Any cryptocurrency user should be able to send funds to human readable names instead of wallet addresses, and know if recipient is legit
solution: To build a decentralized network that maps names and other information to wallet addresses, much like the internet's DNS but for wallets.

title: Cardano IPFS chronicles
problem: IPFS is widely used in the Cardano ecosystem. Data stored on IPFS is prone to disappear if not used and will be lost forever.
solution: We have built a community service where we archive all IPFS data that appears on the Cardano blockchain for future generations.

title: ADAvoice: Decentralized E-invoicing
problem: Traditional payment between companies are opaque, human-based and complex to audit. Debtors can delay payment or not respect commercial term
solution: E-invoice as transaction metadata and smart contract managing inter-exchange between companies (self-invoicing, periodic invoices,...)

title: DEFI billing - an untapped market?
problem: Consider the vast number of utilities & other Gov orgs that bill customers on a regular basis using expensive inflexible insecure solutions.
solution: Propose to develop a billing smart contract solution targeting use cases around initially Utilities billing. Calling it "adabillr" or Billr

title: NFT for each CARDANO Smart Contract
problem: Cardano needs to implement the NFTs to its technology and to Smart Financial Contracts of its MARLOWE platform to be a leader in said market
solution: Implement the NFT generation function in the Cardano MARLOWE platform so that each Financial Smart Contract created has its respective NFT

title: Wrap NTFs
problem: There is a great opportunity to bring NTFS tokens to the DEFI market
solution: Give tocken NTFs the opportunity to participate in DEFI platforms by using NTFS wrap

title: 60-Day Online Marketing Campaign
problem: Low awareness of Catalyst among entrepreneurs outside our community, and thus a lot of untapped potential for Cardano development
solution: Online Marketing Campaign as a fast and efficient way to attract entrepreneurs to increase diversity and quality of proposals in Catalyst

title: Back to Basis - Tax compliance tool
problem: Tax compliance obligations under US tax policy are difficult to track correctly, especially when on chain transactions are involved.
solution: Develop a web based tax solution that can easily manage both the on chain activity of Cardano, as well as the staking reward activity.

title: Sponsorship for Brazilian youtuber
problem: A large part of the Brazilian population does not know what blockchain, crypto and cardano are.
solution: Lack of knowledge is resolved with quality information and easy language. I will produce content weekly to clarify the Brazilians

title: Community Launchpad & DEX
problem: New projects lack initial liquidity and fail to compete based on the value they generate.
solution: All-in-one ecosystem from activating a project community to token launch and swap. We offer a inclusive, transparent, secure solution.

title: NFTDAO: Industry Standards 1 (dues)
problem: Mainstream adoption of NFTs require standards to give organizations confidence in their long term stability and consistency.
solution: Industry Standards Organizations develop standards for adoption across multiple vendor implementations, these are starting to form for NFTs.

title: Social Spider Web of Decision
problem: How do we diversify and increase participation?
solution: To build participation we need to build trust by utilizing social media and group gatherings (online and off).

title: cardanocataly.st Community Page
problem: A central place for new and existing community members of Project Catalyst to find information, make connections, obtain guides.
solution: Continue development a community driven Community Landing Page that links to the various material relating to Project Catalyst.

title: UnicornHire Recruitment Platform
problem: There are a number of areas of dissatisfaction and risk within the recruitment process, ranging from Bias, Data/ID security and Ghosting
solution: We will implement gender bias removal through Cardano, ID sovereignty through Atala and candidate, company and offer contracts though Plutus

title: Cardano Support for Point of Sale
problem: Cardano has no easy Point-of-Sale software integration, and therefore requires expensive custom solutions for website payments.
solution: Adding Cardano support to BTCPay Server would enable easy web payments for ecommerce websites and online services.

title: Catalyst Site: Collaborators list
problem: It's difficult for newcomers and proposers to find people for collaboration on a proposal or get advice on engaging in Project Catalyst.
solution: A list of potential collaborators and their skills that want to take part in proposals.

title: Stiff Money | Crowdlending PaaS
problem: Getting a stable Annual Percentage Yield (APY) on the assets your holding is hard. And getting a loan to buy a home is even harder.
solution: Stiff Money offers depositors of ADA and other cryptos a 10% APY. And offers homebuyers a no-down-payment lease to own smart contract loan.

title: DubT contract-driven livestream NFT
problem: How can we rapidly deploy NFT to support performing artists that fall outside of the mold of NFT graphic artist?
solution: DubToken allows streaming creators to both fund unique performances and mint stream-derived NFTs through a contract-directed media service.

title: Font Management App
problem: We want to make it easy for Creatives to manage, share and sell fonts. No blockchain app yet developed that boosts scalability of Font Mgmt.
solution: An app that fulfills functionality to manage, share & sell own-created fonts by Creatives, being a single source, lean & easy to use

title: Food Delivery App + Low Commissions
problem: Uber Eats takes advantage of restaurants and delivery drivers with 30-60% commission fees.
solution: Create a white-label decentralized food app which directly connects consumers to restaurants.

title: Why Should I Choose Cardano?
problem: How do you get entrepreneurs to develop on Cardano?
solution:
Hurdle: Why Cardano? Creation of a YouTube Channel dedicated to News with a tint of Cardano, the positive impacts.
Answer: Incentivization.

title: Cardano JS API
problem: At this point, only an in-depth study of how Cardano works allows you to make the simplest Javascript web application.
solution: Develop library on top of cardano-graphql and cardano-serilazation-lib, with transparent methods to work with Cardano cryptography & data.

title: Hands-On Marketing in Addis Ababa
problem: Enormous untapped potential in Ethiopia! Many devs and entrepreneurs are unaware of Catalyst. How can we encourage them to submit proposals?
solution:
Engage community via information sessions at local tech hubs
Hang posters and hand out flyers with specifics on upcoming Catalyst rounds

title: Workspace for JavaScript Developers
problem: Allow developers to work on their projects while contributing to open source libraries at the same time.
solution: I created a workspace to develop my own projects while contributing to open source libraries and other developers can use it too.

title: ADA Liquidity for Ethiopia
problem: For those in Ethiopia without access to traditional exchanges, purchasing ADA is prohibitively difficult and expensive.
solution: Provide free exchange of Ethiopian Birr for ADA via in person and mobile transactions.

title: ADD.xyz's DeFi Mobile Money Bridge
problem: APY's of financial products in Africa has dropped from 20% to 2% APY in the past 5 years due to deflation, political corruption and covid-19
solution: We propose to build the first ever MTN/Mobile Money Bridge to DeFi in Nigeria/Kenya using Mobile Merchant On-ramps and lending protocols.

title: Glow Formal verification
problem: Catastrophic bugs keep developers from wanting to build DApps, because the risk of losing all the assets in the DApp is terrifying.
solution: MuKn's Glow language will overcome this problem by automatically proving the mathematical correctness of every interaction of a program.

title: Dandelion: Cardano API market
problem: There are too few professional deployments of Cardano API gateways. This limits the ability of light dApps and services to operate at scale.
solution: Build a market of API gateway deployments that serves as backbone for projects; specially for DeFi ones, whose criticality is high.

title: WooCommerce Payments Plugin
problem: Peer to peer ADA payments via open source e-commerce platforms such as WooCommerce for low volume/value merchants.
solution: WooCommerce plugin to allow users to pay ADA directly to merchants without the need for a third party.

title: C64 NFTs Minter(on-chain+identity)
problem: Minting signed assets fully on-chain , allowing creators to distribute authenticated and verifiable content with long-term availability.
solution: Development of a light wallet that provides sovereignty to mint and sign non-fungible tokens (NFTs) 100% on-chain from digital assets .

title: From Plastic Waste 2 Social Housing
problem: Slumdogs and plastic pollution in Ecosystems are social and environmental issues growing with the urbanization across the African continent.
solution: Deployment of Social housing campaigns using Plastic Waste-2-Brick proven technology, and social embedded waste collection programs.

title: Storage of medical metadata
problem: Medical documentation should be safe and cost-efficient. Outdated systems makes the process ineffective, non-standardized and expensive.
solution: Storage of medical data on blockchain safely and standardized which allows for further implementations and increases overall patient safety.

title: Magento 2 ada payments plugin
problem: Currently, there are no plugins for ADA on the Magento marketplace. Over 170k websites use the Magento platform.
solution: Build a payment system that can be used on the Magento platform. We plan on building a plugin that any website on Magento can use.

title: Barriers to Entry = Proposals
problem: People find it intimidating to start participating in Project Catalyst.
solution: Weekly workshops for "Catalyst Skeptics" in which newcomers identify barriers to entry that can be reframed as the seeds of new Proposals.

title: ErgoDex Plutus Port
problem: We need a non-custodial decentralized exchange allowing us to transfer a liquidity over the Cardano network easy, fast and secure.
solution: ErgoDEX - a decentralized exchange that combines AMM with OrderBook in a single app in order to provide best user experience.

title: Oracle Performance Metrics
problem: Decentralised applications and the oracles on which they depend have a need to demonstrate their reliability and utility over time.
solution: Periodically store performance metadata that has been appropriately signed for authenticity and provide a tool for aggregating this data.

title: Democratised AlgoTrading on Cardano
problem: Classic blockchain rewards focus on market making fees, PoS rewards & lending, leaving a big revenue area of automated trading untapped.
solution: Develop automated ML trading ensemble method based on following top K=100 traders centralised exchange accounts and wallets.

title: Kingdom Builder
problem: Most low level users in crypto's first and only experience with crypto is on Coinbase and then nothing after that.
solution: I want to create a a platform that anyone can join, buy crypto and actively transact on the blockchain (maybe without even knowing it)

title: IdeaScale Improvements
problem: Obstacles prevent Fund Proposers from expressing themselves in the Cardano community and Community Advisors from reviewing proposals.
solution: We are proposing making improvements to the IdeaScale platform will allow the Cardano community to make better decisions.

title: The Game of Life
problem: How do we get developers to develop on Cardano?
solution: Incentivized referral gaming. Creating a gaming system approachable to children. It looks like a game, but they are actually developing apps

title: ALDEA Catalyst Spanish Support Site
problem: There's a gap between Catalyst and a fast-growing Spanish Community, eager to participate and learn to do so in their native language.
solution: ALDEA Catalyst is a site for people to find information in Spanish about Catalyst and develop hot valuable skills for the ecosystem.

title: Cardacity: a trading card game
problem: There is a lack of casual apps/games built on Cardano which will be key in order to attract less technical crowds to the project.
solution: A trading card game where each card represents a city. Players can buy and sell cards with ADA. Dynamic events to make the market move.

title: T0 Intraday Liquidity Management
problem: to settle liquidity transactions intraday using available options such as repo, commercial paper and margin.
solution: Atomic settlement of cash transactions using automated "smart contract" programs.

title: Developer Evangelist Japan
problem: Japanese Developers and Entrepreneurs need specialized local support to get to know the ecosystem.
solution: A specialized developer evangelist will be supporting the local ecosystem in Japanese, and also managing multiple activities.

title: Co-participation fund: adafund.io
problem: Obtaining funding through the existing Project Catalyst funding model is slow and overbearing. How can we explore options to make it faster?
solution: Create a side treasure that explores different funding models. In this case, a co-funding model exploring funding for low cost proposals.

title: Tokenizing GitHub Pull request
problem: Developers want to contribute to projects but at the same time they want to be rewarded either by token of appreciation or recognition.
solution: An extension on GitHub that allow any project owner to tokenised the PR (Pull request) and reward contributors with ADA.

title: A DEX aggregator on Cardano
problem: There is a shortage of DEXs, Dapps building on Cardano's Ecosystems
solution: Instamo - A cross-chain DEX aggregator attracts other startups and businesses building the other DEXs on Cardano to grow global communities

title: Valorem: Thriving local economy
problem: Small businesses are shutting down or barely surviving while Amazon & UberEats breaking records, setting them up to utter market domination.
solution: Tool for restaurants & gig workers collaborate, be profitable, improve their cash flow, & compete with big corporations, not barely survive.

title: Corona Immunity Passport
problem: While travelling, how can every country trust each others Vaccination certificate (in local language) - an APP or a simple piece of paper.
solution: Use Cardano to develop a tamper resistant system, which can be used by the whole world and eases travelling, visiting restaurants etc.

title: Learn and Earn: Developer Training
problem: The learning curve for newcomers in the Cardano Development Ecosystem is too steep. This poses a barrier to developer adoption.
solution: We soften the developer learning curve by providing instructional training with ADA incentives, through our Learn and Earn program.

title: NFTDOT.IO-enable adoption of NFT&FT
problem: Adoption of assets tokenization, goods digital receipts, digital art, digital ownership transfer is met with technical and market barriers
solution: NFTDOT.IO focuses on token creation at lower cost and high utility for wider adoption: FT exchange, NFT gallery with sales & auction.

title: E-ROW waterways transportation
problem: Millions of people are commuting daily in Africa using fossil energies which makes the cost of transport high, second expense per household.
solution: Smart grid pontoon recharge electric boat by using kinetic energy of water. Customer pay with token to local entrepreneur and get rewarded.

title: YOGA+ on PRISM
problem: Yoga has always been too offline and out of balance. A pre-covid billion dollar industry was already wrought with a myriad of dysfunction.
solution: A market network empowering the yogi ecosystem, built using the best available platforms and tools.

title: DEED IT FORWARD
problem: What is our GREATEST untapped resource? We are! Pay it forward is great concept, but how can we do more to actively help our fellow humans?
solution: DeeditForward is a tool that crowdsources the act of helping; connecting a person in need with those willing to help in their own community.

title: Indigenous Source Dev Tools +Events
problem: Digital services for Intellectual Property are not available to Indigenous Communities, excluding them from fair and legal representation.
solution: Bring in local developers on a journey to solve the IP problem among indigenous communities for them to earn more from their craft.

title: Animal Conservation - NFT Rewards
problem: Animals in Africa and other countries are being killed to extinction by poachers, climate change and deforestation.
solution: Develop a Staking Rewards Distribution System via a Smart Contract to support these Organizations and the Supporters with NFTs

title: paypixl - Validating Drone Metadata
problem: Customers ordering drone imagery need to validate the metadata of collected drone imagery to ensure images weren't edited or modified.
solution: Use a hybrid blockchain + traditional data send method to send/receive images and supporting documents with blockchain metadata validation.

title: Smart Contract Audit Token SCAT DAO
problem: Consumers have trouble trusting DeFi Dapps with their money. Dapps can be audited, but how can you trust a paid auditor to act impartially?
solution: A DAO which will have audit projects chosen by the community and funded entirely through their treasury with zero conflict of interest.

title: Crowdfunding Website for Proposals
problem: Catalyst funding levels are not sufficient to guarantee successful implementation of a medium-large projects. They need follow-on funding.
solution: Innovatio can be a commercial complement of Catalyst organized to help 100s & 1000s of proposal seeking funds.

title: End-to-End No-code Cardano Apps
problem: Can we take advantage of the no-code movement in order to grow the number of developers on Cardano with a no-barrier entry platform?
solution: Develop a Cardano blockchain module for flycode.io to allow anyone to create end-to-end apps that connect to smart contracts using no code

title: DApp to manage certifications
problem: Anyone in the world should be able to store certifications obtained from training organizations in a secure, accesible and permanent manner.
solution: Create a DApp to connect training organizations with participants and allow storing verified certification records.

title: Crowdsourced map imagery w/ paypixl
problem: Mapping critical resources in growing regions is critical, but difficult to do without ground truth and location-based imagery.
solution: paypixl assigns imagery collection tasks in areas needing mapping data to users with compatible devices and rewards users with ADA coin.

title: Neona 1on1 Lunar Cycle Mentorship
problem: How can we ensure that onboarding newcomers to ecosystem feel relevant, find their path and find clarity with motivational interviewing?
solution: 1on1 weekly raw ideation sessions

title: ADA news in African languages
problem: News about Cardano should be available in native languages in African communities. However, The crypto world is English-speaking oriented
solution: Create a chain of YouTube channels bringing docutainment and a weekly edited news broadcast in native languages

title: Prsona: Dapp for political personas
problem: Political parties represent the people without really knowing much about the people. How can parties collect and use info about the people?
solution: We will build a poll dapp that gathers the political preferences and wishes of people. Parties can use the data to represent people better.

title: Data driven Cardano services
problem: People new to Cardano ecosystem are often overwhelmed when it comes to technology, pool selection for staking as well as choosing a wallet.
solution: Our platform solves these problems through data-driven analysis and decision making by providing intelligent services and tools.

title: NFT platform for art organizations
problem: Traditional art buyers & orgs. (museums/ galleries) don't have enough guidance to utilize NFT marketplaces leaving valuable art & buyers out
solution: We're building a NFT platform & marketplace that attracts new users & organizations to Cardano by providing art curated by art organizations

title: Cardano Catalyst Jobs & Services
problem: Catalyst is growing, we have Fund winners who need to hire implementers, and we have definitely a need for jobs & services place
solution: By creating Cardano jobs & services site we encourage more meaningful participation in Project Catalyst from ADA community and beyond

title: First Ethiopian Stake Pool
problem: There are very few stake pools in Africa and none in Ethiopia today.
solution: We will start the first Cardano stake pool in Ethiopia and use the rewards to sustain the operation & seed additional local Cardano ventures

title: Visual communication for community
problem: Information about Project Catalyst is difficult to digest for many. There is minimal good visual resources to explain complex concepts.
solution: Create visual resources to continue the series of info graphics that visually describe Project Catalyst from Fund 3.

title: Trusted time-tracking and billing
problem: Time tracking and billing of work is currently a messy and time-consuming process that often requires manual input and approval steps.
solution: Project Hours will provide a global framework for time tracking and payments that will greatly improve trust between workers and companies

title: Genome App - Monetise your Genome
problem: 30 million people have had their genome sequenced. Our Gene app will enable them share their DNA for money, to help medical research.
solution: Due to concerns over who has access to their DNA many people refrain from sharing it. We authorise access to specific portions with Cardano.

title: C# SDK for Blockfrost API
problem: C# developers are missing (and asked for) tools to enjoy Blockfrost.io, a service that provides free and public Cardano API to developers.
solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for C# developers.

title: Turning Devs into Blockchain Devs
problem: There are not enough Cardano blockchain developers to deliver on the tidal wave of work coming our way.
solution: Support experienced developers to become experts in Cardano blockchain development.

title: Localize Yoroi for Czech market
problem: Yoroi is missing Czech localization making it difficult to use on the local market.
solution: Provide Yoroi with a localized Czech interface. This needs to be up to date with each new Yoroi update and coordinated with translators.

title: No-Code For Creative Africa
problem: Lack of a Pan-Africa strategy to gain a piece of the 4.07 trillion IT service Market or to meets its growing IT needs.
solution: Make the African Continent the go-to place for No-Code development then upmarket

title: CardanoTales: CNFTs-based RPG game.
problem: CNFT collectibles have seen a wide success in the Cardano community but although the appeal, they can not yet be implemented in games.
solution: We aim to address the lack of proper games with the development of a CNFT-based RPG game, where you can fight, collect and play with CNFTs.

title: Catalyst Catapult
problem: Siloed onboarding efforts lack a unified voice and vision. One-way content educates without engaging. We can't sustain on unpaid volunteers.
solution: Community onboarding engine sustained by incentivized stewardship and paying it forward - let's create conversational experiences together.

title: Governance Co-Laboratory
problem: On-chain governance presents novel challenges and remains difficult to change. How might we make and learn from our mistakes together?
solution: Low-stakes laboratory to experiment with novel organizational structures and processes, free from highly technical considerations.

title: NFT-DAO EZ-Ticket dispenser
problem: Ticket authenticity and scalping at much higher prices make it difficult to control who is buying, selling, or redeeming a ticket.
solution: With NFTs, smart tickets are verifiable, interoperable and have clear ownership. A ticket redeemed at an event lives on in digital wallets.

title: PlayerMint P2: MetaVerse Toolkit
problem: A MetaVerse is forming, yet it does not have an economic backbone that allows its users to own the digital assets they interact with.
solution: Creating an economic toolkit on Cardano so that MetaVerse users can earn, mint, and trade digital assets.

title: Artano - The NFT Art Marketplace
problem: Many NFT marketplaces do not put users first: they have high commission fees, they are hard to navigate, heavily curated and centralized
solution: An NFT marketplace that is user-driven, open to all and fraud-resistant. We want to build a community, not just a product!

title: Trust Graphic Novel & Motion Comic
problem: Blockchain education isn't Africa-focused and often portrays Africans as the beneficiaries instead of the drivers of change.
solution: Trust is a transmedia project - both a graphic novel and motion comic - that teaches African teens and young adults about blockchain.

title: RAY Swap
problem: Cardano ecosystem needs more competitive AMM exchange tools.
solution: Adaptation of the Uniswap smart contracts (which is distributed under the GNU license) for the Plutus platform.

title: Rewarding Payroll Solutions Resume
problem: Resumes are biased. A more trustless system helps hiring & leads to targeted discounts. Advertising in 2021 $649b & a bad hire costs ~$240k.
solution: Qualify workers based on ledger documented wages. Evidence leads to a higher starting salary, reduction of bad hires or unlocking discounts.

title: Dapp to control/monetize your data
problem: $300B surveillance capitalism market broke the customer relationship. People should control & benefit from the use of their personal data
solution: Consent-based customer data (D)app, using smart contracts to record personal data licenses; compensating people for their data & attention

title: The Million ADA Homepage
problem: To encourage people to come to the Cardano space we need to first shows off its unique technologies. Second we need a large community event.
